title: Reading a Delimited Boolean Field
statement: For a Boolean list, read a field by consuming pairs whose second bit is true: each such pair contributes its first bit to the field. A pair whose second bit is false terminates the field, returning the accumulated bits and the remaining list after that pair; if the list ends before a terminator is found, the result is undefined.
